asked.item: Export gave slides.zip instead of MP4

verdict.reason: The FAQ explains that the Slideshow toggle controls ZIP vs MP4 and gives the steps to re-export as MP4.

steps.text: The "Slideshow" toggle controls the export format: Slideshow ON exports a ZIP file of individual slide images, and Slideshow OFF exports an MP4 video file.
Open the visual in the editor and turn OFF the "Slideshow" toggle.
Click "Export" in the top right corner, wait for rendering to finish, then click "Download" to save the MP4 file.
